Issue 4722: a matrix layout request is dropped when the matrix type comes from a template.

Look at the Buffer Definitions comment block near the top of the DXIL output, not at the
source. One pragma at the top of the file asks for a single layout for everything below it,
and the two struct members under it are the same 4x4 float matrix in the same cbuffer. Only
the member declared outside a template gets the layout that was asked for; the one that comes
through the template gets the compiler default instead. Nothing is diagnosed and the compile
succeeds, so this block is the only place the difference is visible.

The DXIL body agrees with the block: the two mul() calls consume different components of the
loaded cbuffer rows, which is what a layout difference means at runtime.
